title: Fix remove container artifact apis
body:
Fixes https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30202

The Container AddArtifact, GetArtifact, and RemoveArtifact APIs in libpod had no callers for at least 5 years. I removed the three methods, the getArtifactPath helper, the artifactsDir constant, and the directory setup and teardown code that only existed to support them.

Signed-off-by: takinosh@redhat.com

comments.body: It failed as there weren't any tests associated with this PR.  I don't think they're necessary, so I tagged the "No New Tests Label" and have restarted the test that failed due to that being missing..
